Dialog_ShortcutsText:
Ctrl+O — Open image A or B
Ctrl+E — Export
1 / 2 / 3 / 4 — Side-by-side / Wipe / Overlay / Heatmap (canvas focused)
F — Fit to view
0 — 100% original pixels
Space + drag — Pan the canvas
Mouse wheel — Zoom at the pointer
Esc — Cancel selection or leave region mode
Ctrl+Z — Undo the last region add or delete
Delete — Delete the selected region
Left / Right — Move the wipe split (Wipe mode, canvas focused)
Dialog_AboutText:
Visual Diff Lab {0}

A local-first workspace for inspecting visual differences between UI screenshots.

Supported images: PNG, JPEG and BMP.
Supported OS: Windows 11 25H2 (build 26100) or later.

Images are processed on this device only. There is no telemetry, account or network upload.
Source files are never modified.
Dialog_OutputTooLargeMessage: This export would be too large to create safely. Reduce the image size or compare smaller screenshots.
